title: Calendar
sub: When a movie comes out, an episode airs and an album is released
emptyList: Nothing is coming up in the next weeks.
truncated: The span holds more entries than one answer carries. The first {{count}} are shown.

feed.title: Subscribe to the calendar
feed.intro: An address a calendar app reads without logging in. It carries a key of its own that opens this calendar and nothing else.
feed.hint: Off by default. While it is off, the address answers nobody.
feed.newKeyDone: The new key applies. Every calendar app holding the old one gets nothing.
feed.warning: Whoever has the address sees this calendar. Only pass it on when that is what you want.
